data.title: Ramhan Island
data.about:
The Heavenly Ramhan Island by Eagle Hills is entirely untouched and natural, with bays, beaches, and mangrove trees awaiting the adventurist traveler’s discovery. Abu Dhabi’s island of Ramhan is circular due to its geological structure.

This masterplan features exquisitely designed 3, 4, 5, 6 & 7 Bedroom beachfront luxury villas with top-tier amenities, a marina with cutting-edge retail and dining options, 5-star accommodations in the form of a hotel and serviced apartments, and a wellness center with bay views and tranquil surroundings.

location_tile.title: Hugging the Shores of Abu Dhabi
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The Ramhan Villas are situated in Abu Dhabi and offer easy access to the city’s mainland and other areas. Ramhan Island will become one of the most coveted locations in the United Arab Emirates’ capital.

  • 10 Mins Yas Island
  • 15 Mins Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
  • 15 Mins Abu Dhabi Airport
  • 18 Mins Saadiyat Island
  • 20 Mins Drive Lovre Abu Dhabi
